# NexRoute 0.6.1 — Hot Bug Fix

Emergency Windows launcher, updater, and control-node repair for the 0.6.0 production release.

## Fixed

- `service.bat` no longer passes a quoted root path ending in `\`, which could make Windows PowerShell receive an illegal `"` character and fail inside `System.IO.Path.GetFullPath`;
- `nexroute.bat`, `service.bat`, and `nexroute-update.cmd` now canonicalize `%~dp0` through `%%~fI`, so installation directories containing spaces or Cyrillic characters are supported;
- launcher exit codes are captured after each command and survive `endlocal` correctly;
- automatic update checks run only for the normal interactive launcher path;
- GitHub API `403`/rate-limit failures fall back to the public stable-release redirect, then delegate deterministic release metadata to the unchanged secure updater core;
- fallback metadata contains ZIP, checksum, JSON validation, and Markdown validation asset URLs under the trusted NexRoute GitHub Release path;
- `nexroute-update.cmd --status` provides a deterministic non-network smoke path for release validation;
- the diagnostic status path no longer passes `-Name` twice in one PowerShell command expression when checking `WinDivert` and `WinDivert14`;
- redirected and hidden `--status` health checks no longer wait for an interactive key press;
- successful control-node checks with an empty stderr file no longer fail because `.Trim()` was invoked on `$null`.

## Security boundary

The fallback does not install unverified content. It only resolves the current stable semantic version and constructs official GitHub asset URLs. The existing updater core still enforces:

- stable tag validation;
- exact archive and checksum asset names;
- trusted `github.com/Onmaynec/NexRoute/releases/download/` URLs;
- checksum format and SHA-256 match;
- package version, required files, 21 strategies, and 23 tracked patch targets;
- backup, state preservation, health verification, and rollback.

## Regression evidence

The Windows package gate copies each extracted online and offline build into a temporary directory named like:

```text
NexRoute 0.6.1 Hot Fix Тест <guid>
```

It then launches all three public entry points through `cmd.exe` and rejects:

- non-zero exit codes;
- `GetFullPath` failures;
- `Illegal characters in path` / `Недопустимые знаки`;
- duplicate PowerShell parameter binding;
- `MethodInvocationException`, `ArgumentException`, or equivalent launcher crashes;
- a status command that blocks until the package health-check timeout.

The complete repository suite also covers installation and rollback migrations from `0.4.1`, `0.5.0`, and `0.6.0` to `0.6.1`.

## Release assets

Keep all four assets together:

- `NexRoute-0.6.1-win-x64.zip`;
- `NexRoute-0.6.1-win-x64.zip.sha256`;
- `NexRoute-0.6.1-validation.json`;
- `NexRoute-0.6.1-validation.md`.

They are generated by the same release workflow and covered by one GitHub artifact attestation.

## Compatibility

This hotfix contains the complete NexRoute 0.6.0 feature set. Existing 0.6.0 user state, service profiles, lists, history, updater state, and backups remain compatible.
